text: USDC is issued by Circle; its parent, Circle Internet Group, Inc., states in its own SEC filing that 'Our Class A common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE") under the symbol "CRCL".' The same filing shows founders Jeremy Allaire and P. Sean Neville holding Class B stock equal to about 30% of voting power post-offering; no state or state-fund owner is named.

source.name: Circle Internet Group, Inc., Form S-1 (follow-on prospectus)
source.quote: Our Class A common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (the “NYSE”) under the symbol “CRCL”.
